classification.difficultyReason: The diagram supplies the givens. The student reads the height as $x$ and each base dimension as the sheet side minus $2x$, then expands a three-factor product into a cubic. It is a standard show-that with one geometric insight and moderate algebra.

content.prompt: Open boxes are made by cutting squares of side $x$ cm from the corners of a sheet of metal and folding up the sides.

children.label: a
children.prompt:
The sheet is 24 cm by 15 cm.

Show that the volume of the box is $V=360x-78x^2+4x^3$.

answer.worked:
The base dimensions are $(24-2x)$ cm and $(15-2x)$ cm, and the height is $x$ cm.
$$\begin{align*}V&=x(24-2x)(15-2x)\\V&=x(360-48x-30x+4x^2)\\V&=x(360-78x+4x^2)\\V&=360x-78x^2+4x^3\text{ cm}^3.\end{align*}$$

children.label: b
children.prompt:
The sheet is a square of side 18 cm.

Show that the volume of the box is $V=324x-72x^2+4x^3$.

answer.worked:
The base is a square of side $(18-2x)$ cm, and the height is $x$ cm.
$$\begin{align*}V&=x(18-2x)^2\\V&=x(324-72x+4x^2)\\V&=324x-72x^2+4x^3\text{ cm}^3.\end{align*}$$
